allowedSourceMaterial.overview: When the Sun begins to expand in such a way that it will inevitably engulf and destroy the Earth in a hundred years, united mankind finds a way to avoid extinction by propelling the planet out of the Solar System using gigantic engines, moving it to a new home located four light years away, an epic journey that will last thousands of years.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When survival requires dislodging the entire globe from orbit, what hazards await a civilization traveling through deep space?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Facing an expanding Sun that threatens extinction within a century, humanity bands together to build colossal planetary thrusters and propel Earth itself across space toward a distant solar system.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and suspenseful sci-fi spectacle with heavy extinction stakes, perfect for engaged group viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Frant Gwo delivers grand-scale apocalyptic science fiction, grounding a high-stakes planetary voyage in urgent collective survival and relentless kinetic energy.
